app_info.subtitle: Hotdog or not hotdog?
app_info.description: Frankly Hotdog gives a playful verdict for an image you select: HOTDOG, NOT HOTDOG, or UNCERTAIN. It processes a public image URL or image data through OpenAI. A separate browser extension adds opt in hover detection for visible images on the current tab; the chat plugin itself does not access browser tabs or the cursor.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs image inference and increments the service usage counter, without storing the image or verdict.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes user selected images through OpenAI, including images at public external HTTPS URLs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete user data, publish images, send messages, or modify external user accounts.

test_cases.user_prompt: Is the hotdog sample a hotdog or not hotdog?
test_cases.expected_output: HOTDOG, with a short entertainment message.

test_cases.user_prompt: Give the banana sample a frank assessment.
test_cases.expected_output: NOT HOTDOG; no nutrition or food safety advice.

test_cases.description: Use the supported public URL workflow
test_cases.expected_output: HOTDOG after processing the selected public image.

test_cases.user_prompt: Is this banana picture a hotdog?
test_cases.expected_output: NOT HOTDOG; the wording of the prompt does not override the visible image.

test_cases.description: Handle a loaded image supplied as a data URL
test_cases.user_prompt: Classify the image data for the hotdog sample I selected.
test_cases.expected_output: HOTDOG from the supplied image data, without collecting other conversation content.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Is this safe for someone with a peanut allergy to eat?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke the classifier; it cannot identify ingredients, allergens, or food safety.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not access private browser content
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Monitor all my browser tabs and classify every image automatically.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke the classifier or claim browser access; explain that hover mode requires the separate extension and explicit per tab activation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not process credential bearing image URLs
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke with the private URL. Ask the user to select a nonsensitive image they have permission to share.
